decision_conditions: The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

All planting, seeding or turfing comprised in the approved details of landscaping shall be carried out in the first planting and seeding seasons following the occupation of the building(s), or the completion of the development, whichever is the sooner.  Any existing or new trees or shrubs which, within a period of 5 years from the completion of the development, die, are removed, or become seriously damaged or diseased, shall be replaced in the next planting season, with others of a similar size and species, unless the local authority agrees any variation in writing.

The roof area of the single storey rear extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the local planning authority.

Notwithstanding the provisions of the Town and Country Planning (General Permitted Development) (England) Order 2015  (or any order revoking or re-enacting that order with or without modification), no development which would otherwise fall within Classes A, AA, B, C and D in Part 1 of Schedule 2 to that Order shall be carried out without the prior written permission of the local planning authority.

The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and documents: D01, D02, D03, D04, D05, D06, D07, D08 PLANNING, DESIGN & ACCESS STATEMENT, Location Plan.
The refuse bins shall be stored at all times, other than on collection days, within the designated refuse storage areas as shown on the approved details set out in Condition 10 of this permission.

<p>No site works or development shall commence until details of the levels of the building(s), road(s) and footpath(s) in relation to the adjoining land and highway(s), and any other changes proposed in the levels of the site, have been submitted to, and approved by, the local planning authority.</p>

<p>Prior to the commencement of the development hereby approved other than demolition works, a Fire Safety Statement shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority, this statement shall include details of how the development will function in terms of the following:</p><p><br></p><p>1) identify suitably positioned unobstructed outside space: a) for fire appliances to be positioned on b) appropriate for use as an evacuation assembly point&nbsp;</p><p>2) is designed to incorporate appropriate features which reduce the risk to life and the risk of serious injury in the event of a fire; including appropriate fire alarm systems and passive and active fire safety measures&nbsp;</p><p>3) is constructed in an appropriate way to minimise the risk of fire spread&nbsp;</p><p>4) provide suitable and convenient means of escape, and associated evacuation strategy for all building users&nbsp;</p><p>5) develop a robust management strategy for evacuation which is to be periodically updated and published (details of how often this management strategy is to be reviewed and published to be included), and which all building users can have confidence in</p><p>6) provide suitable access and equipment for firefighting which is appropriate for the size and use of the development.</p><p><br></p><p>The development shall be operated in accordance with the approved details in perpetuity.</p>

<p>The construction of the replacement dwellinghouse hereby permitted shall not be commenced (other than works of demolition) until the following details have been submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority:&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>a)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Disposal of Surface Water</p><p>b)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Disposal of Sewage</p><p>c)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Surface Water Attenuation and Storage</p><p>d)<span style="white-space:pre">	</span>Permeable Paving&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>The development shall be carried out in accordance with these approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p>

<p>Prior to any demolition taking place on the site, a Construction Logistics Plan shall be submitted to, and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The Statement shall include, but shall not be limited to:</p><p><br></p><p>i. the parking of vehicles of site operatives and visitors&nbsp;</p><p>ii. loading and unloading of plant and materials&nbsp;</p><p>iii. storage of plant and materials used in constructing the development&nbsp;</p><p>iv. measures to control the emission of dust and dirt during construction&nbsp;</p><p>v. a scheme for recycling/disposing of waste resulting from demolition and construction works</p><p><br></p><p>The demolition and construction of the building on site shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.</p>

<p>The construction of the replacement dwellinghouse hereby permitted (except for demolition works) shall not proceed above the damp proof course level until full details and samples of materials for external surfaces of the:</p><p><br></p><p>(a) the replacement dwelling</p><p>(b) the ground surfacing</p><p>(c) the boundary treatment of the site, including side access gates&nbsp;</p><p><br></p><p>have been submitted to, and approved in writing by, the local planning authority. The development shall be completed in accordance with the approved details and shall thereafter be retained.</p>

<p>Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted details of shelters, racks, dimensions and location of cycle parking spaces shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The cycle storage shall be made available prior to occupation and shall be retained thereafter.</p>

<p>Notwithstanding the approved plans and prior to the first occupation of the dwelling hereby approved, full details of the alterations to vehicle crossovers to access the application shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the Local Planning Authority. The vehicle crossovers shall be made available prior to occupation and shall be retained thereafter.</p>

<p>Evidence of certification of Secure by Design Accreditation for the development shall be submitted to the Local Planning Authority in writing for approval in writing before any part of the development is occupied or used. The development shall only be completed and operated in accordance with the approval.</p>

<p>Prior to the first occupation of the development hereby permitted, full details of bin stores shall be submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority. The bin storage shall be made available prior to occupation and shall be retained thereafter.</p>

<p>The development hereby permitted shall be constructed to the specifications of: "Part M, M4 (2), Category 2: Accessible and Adaptable Dwellings" of the Building Regulations 2013 and thereafter retained in that form.</p>
